headline: What should an investor know about Lords LB fund units and how do they work?
summary: Lords LB Asset Management is running a public offering of Baltic Core Property Fund units until 30 September. The fund plans to buy rent-generating Class A offices, starting with the 98%-occupied Artery business centre in Vilnius.
why: Lords LB is a Baltic asset manager, and listed-property and fund offerings are a channel for investors to access commercial real estate. Office demand and occupancy drive returns on such funds.
